result.reason: The redline appropriately extends the licence to affiliates and contractors and permits transfer to a successor under the assignment provision. However, it allows revocation upon any expiration or termination under paragraph 4, rather than limiting termination of a subscription licence to uncured material breach, and it does not make any paid-up licence perpetual and irrevocable. The changes are otherwise targeted and professionally drafted, but the operative language does not reach the preferred licence-duration position.
